name: Huabeisaurus
sum: Huabeisaurus is a Late Cretaceous sauropod from northern China, assigned to Euhelopodidae in recent analyses.
wsnote: Estimate by Pang and Cheng (2000) quoted by the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: Probably HBV-20001, a partially articulated individual from the upper member of the Huiquanpu Formation; the number must be confirmed in the naming paper.
material: Teeth, neck, back, sacral and tail vertebrae, ribs, complete pectoral and pelvic girdles and nearly complete limbs from one individual, plus a paratype humerus from a lower layer.
biology: Remains were found in a fluvial setting and probably belong to a single individual that was partly disarticulated before burial.
author: Pang and Cheng 2000
